IDs have been regenerated for the revised WBS. Bare ID = finish-to-start; SS = start-to-start; lags use working days. A zero-duration submission can occur when predecessor work finishes. Parallel testing uses SS; package gates also require implementation tasks completed.

Static synchronized Gantt, no scheduling formulas. Bars show work windows and diamonds show milestones. Update dates, dependencies and Gantt together. Weekly tracking is a recurring 15-week window, not 75 person-days.
Meet GVHD weekly; maintain Project Schedule, Project Tracking (WBS, Issues, Defects, Q&A) and Project Weekly Report. All members participate; track action owners, actual effort and capacity.

Only if the group fails Council 1.1 or 1.2: revise product/documents, prepare a feedback-response matrix and attend Council 2 about 4 weeks after W15 (~W19, next semester). Reports 1-7 and council presentation use English. Revision 16 Sep 2026: team-confirmed ownership and existing cross-cutting tasks synchronized; council calendar unchanged. Original files archived in docs/archive/2026-09-16-before-team-allocation.

Final scope: reviewed opt-in, firmware/profile compilation, upload/read-back, pilot consent in [T-5 min,start), atomic scheduled dispatch, gateway local checks and observed execution/completion. Owner ThongLQ; NghiaHQ owns planning/preflight; DucDDA owns post-flight; KhanhGNG owns advisory AI.

All gates are conjunctive. Presence/heartbeat <=30 s, telemetry <=15 s, preflight <=60 s; exact UID/lease/plan/compiled hash binding. Envelope expires at start+5 s; retry delivery at most three times with the same commandId; no replay/catch-up. AF-01–16 and UT-AF-01–07 define final acceptance. Execution status is recorded from actual evidence.
